description: de Límites Marítimos del Reino de España (INSPIRE) is a dataset listed in Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ideihm.covam.es. Display service showing the Maritime Limits published in official documents (Agreements, Royal Decrees,...), including: straight baselines declared by the Kingdom of Spain; Limit of the Territorial Sea and Contiguous Zone agreed between France and Spain in the Cantabrian Sea; limits of the Continental Shelf in the Cantabrian Sea agreed by France and Spain, limits of ... Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS of Maritime Limits of the Kingdom of Spain (INSPIRE)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Límites Marítimos, IHM, Líneas de Base, Unidades Marítimas. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-codsi.
